research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Kivo Health is researching systems and methods for remote management of monitored exercise and rehabilitation in the setting of respiratory conditions. The work described in Systems and methods for remote management of monitored exercise and rehabilitation uses sensory and photoplethysmography data to guide therapy for respiratory patients, supporting telehealth delivery of structured lung rehabilitation. Overall, Kivo Health focuses on remote respiratory exercise monitoring, data driven therapy guidance, and tele-rehabilitation for chronic lung disease.

identifier.value: Kivo Health Virtual Pulmonary Rehabilitation and Care Program

product.name: Kivo Health Virtual Pulmonary Rehabilitation and Care Program
product.description: An AI-powered, home-based pulmonary rehabilitation program for people with COPD that combines personalized clinical assessment, supervised exercise, breathing education, medication-management education, and ongoing support.

product.name: Population Health COPD Care Solution
product.description: A virtual COPD rehabilitation and care service for healthcare organizations that identifies eligible patients, delivers at-home pulmonary rehabilitation, and shares engagement and outcome data with existing care workflows.
